description: This file defines a function 'stripMarkdown' that removes lightweight markdown formatting from input text, aimed at producing plain-text suitable for Text-to-Speech (TTS) and channel fallbacks. It uses regular expressions to identify and strip various markdown syntaxes such as bold, italics, strikethrough, headings, blockquotes, horizontal rules, inline code, and multiple newlines.
